chunks: From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Whoever says 'Allah knows what He did not know,' His Throne will tremble for that, out of reverence for Him."
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Throne of Allah trembles due to a specific statement about His knowledge?
ai.summary: In Shia theology, this hadith underscores the doctrine of Allah's eternal and unchanging knowledge, refuting the notion of 'acquisition' (iktisab) which implies temporal change. The trembling of the Throne (al-'Arsh) signifies the cosmic magnitude of this theological error, as it attributes a created characteristic to the Creator. This narration is frequently cited in discussions of divine attributes to affirm that Allah's knowledge is not subject to increase or decrease.
